en: The postcard features a black-and-white illustration or photograph of a mountain lake surrounded by rocky slopes and steep mountains. In the foreground, a person is walking with a dog along the rugged terrain. The background shows misty peaks and a tranquil lake. In the top right corner, there is a German script with text, and a name appears at the bottom right.
